mission.posting: A "client" of ours recently purchased a valuable piece of software, and is refusing to pay. Delete what they now unjustly hold.

email.subject: #CLIENT# - Return Policy
email.body:
Hello Agent,
A client company recently asked to purchase an extremely expensive software package from #CLIENT#, our company, but it seems they never had any intention of paying. Due to some talented legal handling on their part, we are unable to pursue this via traditional means. This is where you come in. We would like to request that you pay a visit to their system, and remove the software that they illegitimately have from us. We transfer our software in archive formats, usually labeled as "#FILE#".
Thank you for your assistance in this delicate and frustrating matter.
-#CLIENT#
